    'Right'
    
    >>> verify_isbn("0-670-82162-0")
    '0-670-82162-4'
    """
    isbn = isbn.replace("-", "")
    if len(isbn) != 13:
        raise ValueError("The ISBN number must be 13 digits long.")
    if isbn[0] != "0" or isbn[1] != "1":
        raise ValueError("The ISBN number must start with '0-1'.")
    if isbn[12] != "0" or isbn[13] != "1":
        raise ValueError("The ISBN number must end with '0-1'.")
    if isbn[12] != isbn[13]:
        raise ValueError("The ISBN number checksum is incorrect.")
